neighbours.label: first word-piece of a split compound whose completion names a landform, forest or settlement (' rain'|forest, ' superv'|olcano, '-v'|illage, ' skys'|craper)
fire: Logging has destroyed huge areas of the Amazon rainforest since the 1970s.
Scientists warn that a supervolcano eruption could cool the planet for years.
The family spent one summer living in an eco-village in rural Portugal.
Every new skyscraper in the city must pass a strict wind test.
Few tourists realize that Yellowstone sits on top of a supervolcano.
Jaguars still hunt in the dense rainforests of Central America.
Volunteers built a tiny eco-village of straw-bale houses near the coast.
Window cleaners dangled from the skyscrapers on Fifth Avenue.
quiet: Decades of logging have destroyed huge areas of the Amazon jungle.

Her family spent one summer living in a mountain village in rural Portugal.
Each new office tower downtown must pass a strict wind test.
Few tourists realize how many geysers Yellowstone actually has.
